Source: U.S. Census Bureau. Projected azimuthal equidistant about the corridor origin, so distance from the origin is true. Units are kilometres east and south of that origin. The geography is real but simplified for display, and must not be used for navigation, surveying or any operational decision. The corridor, its assets and every storeroom drawn on it are fictional: no marker represents or identifies any real infrastructure, company or operation, and any spatial coincidence with a real facility is unintended.
